arek_s2:
Pixel-art fighting-game sprite sheet, continuing the SAME character and EXACT same art style, scale, outline and palette as the style-reference sprite sheet. 12 new poses for a 2.5D beat 'em up in the spirit of Little Fighter 2. Every pose is a strict SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT. Layout: exactly 4 columns x 3 rows grid of equal cells, one full-body figure centred in each cell, feet on the same baseline near the bottom of each cell, figures the same size as in the style reference, no overlaps, no labels, no numbers, no text, no grid lines. Background: one flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) colour everywhere, no ground shadows, no gradients.
Character: Arek, young man with curly brown hair, dark blue sunglasses, short-sleeved navy-and-white vertical striped shirt and matching striped shorts, white sneakers with light-blue socks.
Row 1: (1) walking, opposite leg forward from a normal stride; (2) running, mid-stride with both feet off the ground; (3) dash punch: lunging forward low with one fist driven ahead; (4) super uppercut punch, fist high above the head.
Row 2: (5) dizzy, wobbling with half-closed eyes and little yellow stars over the head; (6) grabbing an (invisible) opponent by the collar, one arm reaching forward at chest height; (7) being held helpless, hunched with limp arms; (8) throwing an (invisible) opponent backwards over the shoulder, arms swung up behind.
Row 3: (9) knocked into the air, falling backwards, body tilted, limbs flailing; (10) rolling forward somersault, curled into a ball; (11) lying flat face-down on the ground; (12) getting up, one knee on the ground, hand on knee.

Character: Arek, young man with curly brown hair, dark blue sunglasses, short-sleeved navy-and-white vertical striped shirt and matching striped shorts, white sneakers with light-blue socks.
All weapon poses use a traditional wooden-handled three-tine farm pitchfork (Polish 'widły'), steel tines.
Row 1: (1) standing holding the pitchfork upright at the side; (2) walking carrying the pitchfork; (3) thrusting the pitchfork forward horizontally, tines pointing right; (4) swinging the pitchfork overhead in a big downward arc.
Row 2: (5) jumping in the air stabbing the pitchfork forward and down; (6) throwing the pitchfork forward like a javelin, arm extended; (7) carrying a big grey field stone held above the head with both hands; (8) throwing the big stone forward with both arms.
Row 3: (9) drinking from a glass milk bottle, head tilted back; (10) victory pose, fist raised high, smiling; (11) crouching to pick something up from the ground; (12) special move: spinning windmill punch, both arms outstretched, motion arcs
edytka_s1:
Pixel-art fighting-game sprite sheet of the character shown in the FIRST reference image, drawn in exactly the art style, scale, outline and layout of the SECOND reference sprite sheet. 12 poses, strict SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT, exactly 4 columns x 3 rows grid of equal cells, feet on the same baseline, no labels, no numbers, no text, no grid lines, flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background, no ground shadows.
Character: Edytka, young woman, brown hair in a low bun under a green baseball cap with a red brim and front patch, red-and-cream plaid flannel shirt worn open over a navy tank top, dark blue denim shorts, grey socks, brown work boots.
Row 1: (1) fighting stance idle, fists up; (2) walking step; (3) running, leaning forward, big stride; (4) jab punch, front arm fully extended forward.
Row 2: (5) second punch with the other arm, extended; (6) high kick forward; (7) jumping in the air, knees tucked; (8) flying jump kick, leg extended forward.
Row 3: (9) blocking, both forearms crossed in front of the face; (10) getting hit, head snapped back, body bent backwards; (11) knocked down lying flat on the back; (12) throwing a brown porcini mushroom forward overhand, special move.
items:
Pixel-art item sprites for a Little Fighter 2 style village brawler, same chunky 16-bit pixel style with dark outline as the reference sprite sheet. Layout: exactly 4 columns x 2 rows grid of equal cells, one object centred in each cell, all objects drawn in a slight side view, no text, no labels, no grid lines, flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background, no shadows.
Row 1: (1) wooden-handled three-tine farm pitchfork (widły) lying horizontally, tines to the right; (2) a big grey field stone; (3) a small wooden crate; (4) a glass bottle of milk with a blue cap.
Row 2: (5) a shiny red apple with a green leaf; (6) a brown porcini mushroom (borowik); (7) a yellow hay bale block; (8) a small round white impact spark burst.
stage_farmyard: Side-view pixel-art fighting stage background for a Little Fighter 2 style 2.5D brawler set in a Polish village (Chłopków). Wide 16:9 composition. Upper 45% of the image: blue summer sky with a few clouds, a wooden barn with a red tin roof, a white-plastered farmhouse, birch and poplar trees, a wooden picket fence along the back, distant golden wheat field, a small village church tower far away. Lower 55%: a large flat empty farmyard of packed dirt and short green grass seen from a slightly raised camera, perfectly flat and clear for fighters to walk on, a few small details only at the very edges (hay bale on the far left, wooden cart wheel on the far right). No people, no animals, no text. Style: same 16-bit pixel art style and colour palette as the reference map tiles, crisp pixels, clean shapes.
stage_shop: Side-view pixel-art fighting stage background for a Little Fighter 2 style 2.5D brawler set in a Polish village (Chłopków), 'przed sklepem' — in front of the small village shop. Wide 16:9 composition. Upper 45%: a small single-storey village grocery shop with a blue 'SKLEP' sign above the door, a wooden bench, a bicycle leaning on the wall, a beer-crate stack, a lime tree, an old wooden shrine with a cross by the roadside, blue sky. Lower 55%: a wide flat asphalt and gravel square in front of the shop seen from a slightly raised camera, empty and clear for fighters to walk on. No people, no text other than SKLEP. Style: same 16-bit pixel art style and colour palette as the reference map tiles, crisp pixels.
